description: Returns the German road rules a visitor needs: low-emission zones (Umweltzone) and the Feinstaubplakette, speed limits (advisory 130), winter tyres, alcohol, the Sunday lorry ban, tolls, Rettungsgasse, what must be in the car, electric cars. Use when someone drives through Germany or asks whether they may enter a city or street. Do NOT use for live traffic or closures: check_autobahn_traffic; to FIND a charger: find_charging_station. city narrows to its zone; place or lat+lon checks a point against the published zone boundaries. Sourced, dated; show the attribution. Not legal advice.

city.description: City the question is about, e.g. "Stuttgart", "München", "Munich". Narrows "lez" to that city's zone and adds the per-city caveat for "ev". Other topics are nationwide. Omit when the question is not about one city.

language.description: Set this on every call to the language the person is writing in: "en" if they wrote English, "de" if they wrote German. Do not leave it out: it defaults to German ("de"), which is only the fallback when the language is genuinely unclear, so an English question sent without it is answered in German — a wrong answer. Place names, station names and road numbers are never translated in either language; in English the German term is kept in parentheses so the person recognises it on signs and in local apps.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS 84) of the point to check against the zone boundaries. Use with lon; otherwise use place.

lon.description: Longitude (WGS 84) of the point to check against the zone boundaries. Use with lat; otherwise use place.

place.description: A street address, district, station or other point ("Alexanderplatz, Berlin", "Kölner Dom") to check against the published low-emission-zone boundaries: inside, outside with the distance, or unknown. Give either place OR lat+lon, never both.

topic.description: Which rule to answer. "lez" = low-emission zone and Feinstaubplakette, "speed" = speed limits including the Autobahn advisory 130, "winter" = winter-tyre duty, "alcohol" = alcohol and drugs, "toll" = car and lorry toll, "truck_ban" = Sunday and holiday lorry ban, "equipment" = what the law requires in the car, "emergency" = 112/110, rescue lane, breakdown, crash, "ev" = electric car (E-Kennzeichen, charging payment, plugs). Omit for a one-line overview of all nine; with place or lat+lon, omitted means "lez".

name: get_driving_rules
